tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Гаррі прокидається в лікарняному крилі. Поруч гора солодощів від фанатів і Дамблдор, який щойно повернувся з Лондона. Ти принесла/приніс Гаррі цукерки й чуєш усю розмову: про Камінь, про маму Гаррі і про те, чому Квірел не міг його торкнутися.
tasks.q_pl: Harry budzi się w skrzydle szpitalnym. Obok góra słodyczy od fanów i Dumbledore, który właśnie wrócił z Londynu. Przyniosłeś Harry'emu cukierki i słyszysz całą rozmowę: o Kamieniu, o mamie Harry'ego i o tym, dlaczego Quirrell nie mógł go dotknąć.
tasks.q_en: Harry wakes up in the hospital wing. Beside him are a pile of sweets from fans and Dumbledore, who has just come back from London. You've brought Harry some sweets and hear the whole conversation: about the Stone, about Harry's mother, and why Quirrell couldn't touch him.

items.q: Harry had ____ opened his eyes. A familiar face was above him.
By the bed lay a pile of ____ from friends and fans.
“What ____ to the Stone?” Harry asked at once.
Dumbledore smiled: “I got back ____. The Stone is safe.”
“But Nicolas and I have decided to ____ it.”
“So Flamel will ____?” “Yes. But to the well-organised mind, death is but the next great adventure.”
Harry asked why Quirrell couldn't ____ him.
“Your mother gave her life to ____ you.”
“____ like that leaves its own mark: not a scar, but something deeper.”
“It's still ____. Quirrell, full of hatred, couldn't bear it.”
“And the cloak?” “It belonged to your ____. I thought you might like it.”
Dumbledore took a ____ from the box.
“I once had a vomit-flavoured one, and I'm afraid I ____ them…”
“But I think I'll ____ a nice toffee. Alas… earwax!”
We all laughed. Ron and Hermione hadn't come in yet, but they were already waiting outside the door.
